usageNotes: Use this to set or correct the system timezone on a specific PDM node. The timezone value must be a valid IANA timezone name as listed in '/usr/share/zoneinfo/zone.tab' on the node (e.g., 'America/Los_Angeles', 'UTC'). Requires the System.Modify privilege on the node; the change is applied immediately and synchronously (returns null, not a UPID).

examples.summary: Set a PDM node's timezone to US Pacific time

tips: Valid timezone names come from the IANA tz database; check '/usr/share/zoneinfo/zone.tab' on the node if unsure of the exact string.
This endpoint applies the change immediately — no reboot required — but services that cache the system clock offset may need a restart to pick up the new zone.
Use 'localhost' as the node value when calling this endpoint directly on the node that is running the API.
